about_the_game:
Synopsis: 

Richard Hartman, a 16-year-old wakes up trapped in hell. Kidnapped and forced into sinister experiments, he finds himself subjected to deadly trials and grotesque traps, trapped in the most disturbing places imaginable consumed by infection and madness.

Developed by a 15-year-old developer, PLAGUE: Outbreak immerses you in intense survival horror:

  • Every bullet counts – Ammo and resources force you to think before you shoot.

  • Immersive horror – Explore blood-soaked corridors and abandoned facilities filled with unspeakable terror.

  • Survive as you can – You can’t always fight, sometimes running is your only option.

  • Psychological horror – The infection not only kills you but slowly consumes your mind.

  • Original narrative – A fresh and unique story in the survival horror genre...

  • Deadly trials and traps – Face twisted experiments and life-or-death trials that push you to the very edge of death.

  • Unravel the truth – Solve puzzles and uncover the secrets behind the outbreak.

  • Lethal enemies – From infected zombies to aberrations born in laboratories, each encounter can be your last.

The infection spreads...
Will you survive the outbreak?

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not suitable for all ages: Frequent violence and gore.

name: PLAGUE: Outbreak
short_description: Richard Hartman, a 16-year-old trapped in hell. Used as a test subject for sinister experiments, he must survive unimaginable horrors. With barely any resources, every bullet counts. Move in silence, survive grotesque trials and stay alive long enough to uncover the truth, if you can…
